correctness.rationale: All parameters and ambient affine hull are specified. Design pair counting gives n≥k(k-1)+1 and n>2k, ensuring coordinate and block-support extrema. The matroid base rank inequalities give the exact halfspaces, so four reflection inequalities are necessary and sufficient. Averaging them yields four universal lower bounds; the uniform center attains their maximum. Algebra proves only the Fano exception and incidence rank makes the Fano center unique. The verified standalone program exhaustively checked five finite models; the symbolic argument establishes the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The Steiner 2-design class contains finite projective planes, affine designs, and many nonisomorphic triple systems. The exact affine invariant is independent of design realization, agrees with hypersimplex asymmetry for every non-Fano design, and singles out the Fano plane as a genuine exceptional geometrical obstruction. Unique centers and exact sharp reflection containment meaningfully add information absent from known Ehrhart/volume or face-count classifications.
